R API wrapper to the Deribit crypto options and derivatives exchange,
supporting both synchronous and asynchronous (promise based) operations.
Provides an R6 market-data client for the public JSON-RPC endpoints
(instruments, ticker, order book, index price, DVOL volatility index,
funding rates, trades, and option-chain book summaries), built on the
shared connectcore transport base.

# Package index

## R Functions

Pure R functions

- [`add()`](https://dereckscompany.github.io/deribit/reference/add.md) :
  Add two numbers
